summary: Mergeable PR with minor issues related to documentation and maintainability.

issues.description: The change introduces a new method `set_antialiased` in `Text` class, but the docstring does not clearly indicate when this method has no effect.
The code in `backend_cairo.py` has a redundant import statement.
The change does not include any tests for the new `get_antialiased` and `set_antialiased` methods in `Text` class.
The code in `text.py` uses inconsistent spacing between method definitions.
